text: i think the one thing you might run into which is why it is not a framework based thing is that we will have problems with recreating a wgpu instance, which is in part solved by not using wgpu on the 2nd window but thats not what we want, so thats not a possible option. the other is updating wgpu or to my knowledge patching it for the version we have ourselves
resolution: Same build as req_2035/2037 — the editor-panel pop-out into a 2nd GPU OS window. This req raised the wgpu concern (recreating a wgpu instance / patching wgpu): confirmed a NON-issue. The 2nd window is a sibling SURFACE on the EXISTING g_instance + g_device (gpu.createWindowSurface reuses g_instance; configureExtraSurface reuses g_device/g_adapter) — exactly what the shipping world_window.zig already does. No new instance, no new device, no wgpu update/patch. The only format wrinkle (extra surface may negotiate a different format than the main) is handled by rendering the panel into an offscreen RT in the main format and blitting format-agnostically into the 2nd swapchain. Builds clean; needs live 2-monitor verification.
